Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Singing games

This lesson covers Singing games, part of Strand 1 in Grade 3 MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.
